# Vendored Viewer Libraries

This mock vendors the same image-viewer stack used by LoveIt:

- `lightGallery 2.5.0`
- `lg-thumbnail`
- `lg-zoom`
- `lazysizes 5.3.2`

The files were copied from LoveIt's vendored assets only for this local static mock, so the mock works from `file://` without a CDN.

Source references:

- https://github.com/dillonzq/LoveIt
- https://github.com/sachinchoolur/lightGallery
- https://github.com/aFarkas/lazysizes
